summary: The `ansible.builtin.combine` filter creates a dictionary by merging existing dictionaries.
questions: How do I merge two dictionaries in Ansible?
What does the combine filter do?

answer_card.title: combine filter
answer_card.answer_md: `ansible.builtin.combine` (filter plugin) creates a dictionary by merging existing dictionaries, e.g. `{{ dict1 | ansible.builtin.combine(dict2) }}`.
